title: Review-comments headless plan
description: The structured plan a headless /review-comments run writes to the plan file. Every review comment is classified into exactly one type with a confidence; the act phase applies the plan. See docs/adr/0003-review-loop-contract.md.

needsHuman.description: True when any comment needs human judgment (pushback or question). Derived from the comments; the schema enforces the consistency.

allOf.description: needsHuman is set exactly when at least one comment is pushback or question.

commentId.description: The GitHub review-comment or issue-comment id.

path.description: File path for an inline thread; null for a general comment.

line.description: Diff line for an inline thread; null for a general comment.

type.description: answer: supply requested info; pushback: reasoned disagreement; question: needs human judgment; implement: apply the change.

reply.description: The reply the act phase posts to the thread.

confidence.description: The classifier's confidence in the type assignment.

allOf.description: The confidence gate: an implement comment must carry confidence >= 0.8; anything below must have been downgraded to question.
